Name: Strength
Description: A measure of a character's physical power. It determines how hard they can strike and how much they can lift, hold, or break. High strength helps deliver devastating blows and carry heavy equipment.

Name: Dexterity
Description: A measure of a character's agility and coordination. It reflects their ability to move precisely, quickly, and reliably. Dexterity determines how well they avoid traps and blows, handle tools, and mix potions without spilling a drop.

Name: Perception
Description: A measure of a character's ability to notice details and dangers. It determines the chance of spotting traps, hidden items, or an enemy's incoming attack.

Name: Intelligence
Description: A measure of a character's mental abilities. It determines how easily they uncover the secrets of unfamiliar items, understand mechanisms, and show an aptitude for alchemy.

Name: Constitution
Description: A measure of a character's physical endurance. It determines how much hardship and injury they can withstand. Constitution affects maximum health and how quickly it increases when leveling up.

Name: Weapon Mastery
Description: This skill helps a character use any weapon more effectively and miss less often.

Name: Mechanics
Description: Knowledge of mechanics helps a character pick locks and disarm traps.

Name: Stealth
Description: The ability to remain unnoticed, stay out of sight, and avoid waking the sleeping inhabitants of the dungeons.

Name: Echo of knowledge
Description: This is more of an innate ability than an acquired skill. A character with this skill has an intuitive understanding of the sciences and technologies of past civilizations, allowing them to understand and use their devices and artifacts.
